reviewer: Codex parent (/root), manual visual inspection; not an independent second human annotator

usage.source_history: All nine groups were already TRAIN and used for H78 training/H81-H82 development calibration; not new independent data. Original H82 teacher score remains 69/81 and N precision 37/42.
usage.uncertain_policy: Retain explicit uncertain target in audit; exclude all eight from exported definite P/N training rows.
usage.box_convention: Manual integer edge coordinates in native pixels; floor x1/y1 and ceil x2/y2 when normalized to 0..1000. Axis-aligned visible extents only; occluders can lie inside the rectangle, hidden bounds are not extrapolated.

final_overlay_review.limitations: Single Codex-parent manual review, not independent multi-human consensus or pixel-mask ground truth. No claim of mathematically zero annotation error.
